Thunderbird is a 100% open source, privacy focused email app.

Curated listing: Thunderbird Beta for Testers is an open-source project by MZLA Technologies (Thunderbird). BetaPod is not affiliated with its developers. This is Thunderbird's official beta app on Google Play: install it to test upcoming releases and report issues at https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues

Screenshot: MZLA Technologies (Thunderbird), Apache-2.0, from https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android
